verbatim_quote.original: Do not just fix the prompt; study what the top tools do, learn the lessons, then find our gaps.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: Do not just fix the prompt; study what the top tools do, learn the lessons, then find our gaps.

extracted_decision.summary: Use an evidence-based gap-analysis approach: research external top-tool practices, weigh them against house constraints, then propose prompt changes only for identified gaps.
extracted_decision.rationale: The Manager wants lessons from leading tools rather than a local patch, but external advice must be tested against evidence discipline, no-sycophancy, professional register, English-only rule, and reviewability.
alternatives: Directly patch the known style issues without external research
Copy top-tool style guidance wholesale without gap analysis
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Adds research and rejection-analysis burden; Improves root-cause fixes without importing incompatible external norms
